features: Independent production groups with group-only or whole-line stop propagation and concurrent responses
Operator self-fix with escalation to Engineering on the same incident
Per-station failure catalogues with automatic Others, touch paging and search
Daily idle-time roster refresh and a manual Settings refresh with offline saved names
Configurable request budgets, durable background delivery and standalone incident history
Adaptive fullscreen kiosk Settings, touch feedback and stable group/conveyor animation
fixes: Avoid repeated crew-directory requests and preserve cooldown deadlines across restarts
Retain operator decisions and queued updates through network loss and failed acknowledgements
Prevent animation item churn and unnecessary redraws beneath static dialogs
Keep short-screen station actions and Settings Save/Cancel controls reachable
Preserve complete directory pagination under small API budgets and reject ambiguous recipients
Keep connector data and newer configuration extensions during supported version changes
release.release_summary: Local-first production response with independent station groups, operator self-fix and handover, flexible failure reasons, daily saved-team refresh, adaptive kiosk controls and safer offline updates.
security: Bounded strict JSON, private state/checkpoints and hardened audit-file handling
Ambiguous writes require verified idempotency or explicit protected reconciliation
Read-only update compatibility checks refuse unsafe downgrades without deleting data
Software probation requires a healthy GUI before confirmation
Release bundles contain no real connector credentials, saved incidents or private signing material
